Welcome, Our Dearest Guests

A note before the details — please read this first.

Welcome to our beach wedding — bare feet, salt air, and the people we love most. Thank you for flying all this way to Bali to stand with us on the sand.

Everything you need is on this page: times, addresses, where to stay, what to wear, and the RSVP at the bottom. If anything is unclear, message us. We would rather answer twice than have you guess once.

— Mia & Noah

〜 〜 〜

Our Story

How we met, and how we got here — in four moments.

2021 — A Surf Lesson

We met in the waves

Mia was teaching beginners; Noah was the worst beginner of the day, proudly. He fell off seven times. She laughed seven times. He came back the next day anyway.

2022–2025 — The Coast Habit

Weekends by the sea

Every free weekend became the coast — surf at dawn, fish dinners at dusk, and sand in everything they owned. Noah surfs; Mia swims. The habit never stopped.

January 2027 — At Sunset

He asked barefoot on the beach

On a warm evening at Coral Bay, as the sun went down over the water, Noah asked properly, ring in a shell. Mia said yes, then made him ask again so the waves could be in the video.

15 August 2027 — Today, With You

Now we want you in the room

Bare feet, salt air, and the people who made us who we are. That is the whole plan — and the only thing missing is you.

Venue, Travel & Stay

Flying in? Start here, then pick a hotel that fits your budget.

The Venue

Coral Bay Beach Resort, Bali — our recommended base if you want one place for the whole celebration.

Open in Google Maps →

Getting Here

Ngurah Rai Airport (DPS) is the nearest airport. Allow about 45 minutes by car to Coral Bay in normal traffic — book your ride in advance for the main evening.

Parking & Shuttle

Parking is available at the venue where noted in the FAQ. There is no arranged shuttle between hotels, so please plan a ride for each evening and pre-book for late returns.

Where to Stay

Price bands are indicative for planning only — please confirm live rates when you book.

Budget — beach guesthouses & hostelsIndicative band: lower nightly rates. Simple beach stays near Coral Bay; allow a short ride to the resort.
Mid-range — Coral Bay HotelIndicative band: mid nightly rates. A ten-minute ride from the resort, with a pool and breakfast.
Premium — Coral Bay Beach Resort (venue hotel)Indicative band: higher nightly rates. Stay where the wedding is — the beach at your door every morning.

Travelling with children or elderly family? Tell us in the RSVP message and we will help you choose the most comfortable option.

Questions, Answered

Tap a question to open it.

Yes — children are welcome. Please include them in your guest count so we can seat and cater for them. The beach brunch is the most child-friendly part.

Only if your invitation names a plus-one, or you have confirmed one with us directly. If unsure, write it in the RSVP message and we will confirm — seating is planned by name.

Parking is available at the resort car park. If you are staying elsewhere, taxis are easy by day; pre-book for the late return after dancing.

Beach formal, light fabrics. No heels on sand — bare feet or flat sandals. Bring a light layer; the sea breeze cools fast after sunset.

No gift is expected — your presence is the gift. If you wish to give, a honeymoon contribution is welcome; ask us personally for details.

August in Bali is warm and usually dry, but a short shower is possible — the dinner is under cover if it rains. The ceremony is on sand, so flat shoes or bare feet are essential.

Beach formal in light fabrics: linen, cotton, and colours that love the sea. Bare feet welcome on the sand — please avoid heels entirely; they sink, and nobody wants that.
